site.sitedescription: Small sinkhole pond almost completely occupied by Nyssa aquatica. Water is darkly stained with tannins. Upland vegetation: oak-hickory-pine forest with Quercus alba, Q. falcata, Q. palustris, Q. bicolor, Q. macrocarpa, Carya cordiformis, Acer saccharum, A. rubrum, Fraxinus pennsylvanica, F. tomentosa, Ostrya virginiana, and Pinus echinata.
